_comment: Permission settings for the UNATTENDED Sunday devlog cron run only.
Not used by interactive sessions.
Why: the cron runs Claude with --permission-mode acceptEdits, so file
edits are auto-approved with nobody watching, and its inputs include git
commit messages. Today that is safe because there is one committer. It
stops being safe the moment outside contributions land, which is a stated
goal of build-plan.md -- a commit message is attacker-controlled text, and
it would be flowing into an agent that can write files unsupervised.
The fix is blast radius, not detection: /devlog only ever writes
devlog/updates/*.md and edits devlog/journal.md, so everything else in the
repo is denied.
SYNTAX WARNING, verified empirically 2026-08-25: a Write(path) rule is
SILENTLY IGNORED by file permission checks. Only Edit(path) rules apply,
and they cover every file-editing tool including Write. A deny list
written with Write(...) looks like a control and is not one.
Do NOT add a catch-all like Edit(./*) -- also tested: it matches the
project directory itself and denies everything, including devlog, which
would silently break the Sunday draft.
LIMITATION: this list is an enumeration, so a NEW top-level file or
directory is not covered until it is added here.
